Run-step event younger than interval proves the row; at recheck epoch the row demands a real action again.

Named OPEN ship: base refused, changed accepted (backlog_wait receipt); done / missing / non-ship / captain-hold / unnamed blocker / asker-deadlock all re-demand.
Standing deferral with older presentation outstanding: base ack rc=1, changed ack rc=0.
Exclusions: stalled_worker, review_pass_not_merged, open_pr, blocked status verb, captain-held question stay refused with category routes and no automatic receipt.
Second unevidenced deferral and waiting refused with actionable text; escalation completes.
Hung reader: pass ended at ~5s deadline, concurrent receipt write completed at 1.8s while it ran, unread row still gated ack, no orphan reader left.
60 overdue check-in rows: base ack refused; changed code acked after 1 presentation pass, no steer sent.
